notes:
{鼠|ねずみ} is the general term for mice and rats - small rodents found worldwide.

WRITING:
The kanji {鼠|ねずみ} is complex (13 strokes) and often written in hiragana as ねずみ in everyday use.

TYPES:
- ⟦{家鼠|いえねずみ}→家鼠：noentry⟧: house mouse
- ⟦{溝鼠|どぶねずみ}→溝鼠：noentry⟧: brown rat, sewer rat
- ⟦{野鼠|のねずみ}→野鼠：noentry⟧: field mouse
- ⟦ハムスター→ハムスター：noentry⟧: hamster (a popular pet)

CHINESE ZODIAC (⟦{十二支|じゅうにし}→十二支：27602_juunishi⟧):
- ⟦{子|ね}→子：noentry⟧ is the first of the twelve zodiac animals
- ⟦{子年|ねどし}→子年：noentry⟧: Year of the Rat
- People born in rat years are said to be clever and resourceful

- ⟦{窮鼠|きゅうそ}→窮鼠：noentry⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧: a cornered rat will bite a cat (desperation leads to unexpected action)

- {鼠|ねずみ}⟦{一匹|いっぴき}→一匹：08930_ippiki⟧⟦{通|とお}さない→通す：02300_toosu⟧: not letting even a mouse through (airtight security)

COLOR:
⟦{鼠色|ねずみいろ}→鼠色：noentry⟧: mouse-gray (a muted gray color popular in traditional Japanese aesthetics)

- Mice/rats have mixed symbolism in Japan
- Associated with ⟦{大黒天|だいこくてん}→大黒天：noentry⟧ (god of wealth) - mice are his messengers
- Also seen as pests that damage crops and spread disease
